compatibility: Only the exact registered calibration-file hash pair is allowed for report derivation under the original environment and internally consistent fingerprint. Objective/operator source changes are rejected. Fitting and resume retain strict source checks.
correction: Recompute certification for each requested rho from valid bounds, both relative gaps and movement uncertainty. Cached flags retain their original fit scope; new fits record fit_certification_rho. Matching and endpoint qualification use the requested rho.
measurement_policy: Original arrays, scalars, trial seeds, predictions and source identity remain immutable. The original path allowance is exhausted; the point is excluded without a replacement fit. Primary measurements retain their recorded values.
reproduction: Use the original_fitting_revision to inspect the bounded archived fitting trajectory. Current code supports scalar reconstruction and registered report-only audit of its saved arrays. Corrected fitting requires a fresh independent study and artifact root.
stage: Post-study correctness correction; no additional fitting
